## Checks

- [ ] Local checks pass (ruff, pytest / lint, format:check, test, build)
- [ ] CI green
- [ ] Diff re-read before merge
- [ ] Nothing written to Svampekortet or its cloud resources
- [ ] No force push, history rewrite or deletion of resources

## Needs a human?

- [ ] No: ordinary development, safe to merge
- [ ] Browser test needed (MapLibre / map init)
- [ ] Expert review needed (safety, contamination, health, legality, depth/harvest content)
- [ ] User decision needed (public access, secrets, billing, domains, licences)
